True def transform(grid):
    sep = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[c] != 0 for row in grid))
    left_width = sep
    right_width = len(grid[0]) - sep - 1
    width = min(left_width, right_width)
    return [[2 if grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[r][sep + 1 + c] != 0 else 0 for c in range(width)] for r in range(len(grid))]
